title: Revisiting data-driven dynamic security assessment with a tabular foundation model
abstract: arXiv:2607.16031v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data-driven pre-fault dynamic security assessment (DSA) rapidly evaluates the dynamic risk of credible contingencies on a power system using machine learning (ML). Existing approaches face two limitations. First, they require a large labelled database for training, with a separate model trained, tuned, and maintained for each contingency in a potentially long list of credible contingencies. Second, the trained models generalize poorly to unseen contingencies. This work addresses these limitations by using a tabular foundation model (TFM) that assesses stability through in-context learning, and requires no retraining or hyperparameter optimization. We use a single TFM to assess many contingencies at once, removing the need to train one classifier per contingency. We also characterize when using electrical distance coordinates (EDC) as continuous features enables the TFM to generalize to unseen contingencies and when it does not,

translated_title: 基于表格基础模型的数据驱动动态安全评估再审视
translated_abstract: 数据驱动的故障前动态安全评估（DSA）利用机器学习（ML）快速评估电力系统中可信偶然事件的动态风险。现有方法面临两个局限性：首先，它们需要大量的标注数据库进行训练，且对于可能很长的可信偶然事件列表中的每一个偶然事件，都需要单独训练、调优和维护一个模型；其次，训练好的模型对未见过的偶然事件泛化能力较差。本工作通过使用一种表格基础模型（TFM）来解决这些局限性，该模型通过上下文学习来评估稳定性，无需重新训练或超参数优化。我们使用单个TFM同时评估多个偶然事件，从而无需为每个偶然事件训练一个分类器。我们还刻画了使用电气距离坐标（EDC）作为连续特征何时能够使TFM泛化到未见过的偶然事件，以及何时不能。
tldr: 该论文提出使用表格基础模型（TFM）通过上下文学习进行电力系统动态安全评估，仅需单一模型即可同时评估多个偶然事件，无需逐个偶然事件训练分类器或进行超参数优化，并可泛化到未见过的偶然事件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using a tabular foundation model (TFM) with in-context learning for power system dynamic security assessment, where a single model assesses multiple contingencies at once—eliminating per-contingency classifier training, retraining, and hyperparameter optimization—while generalizing to unseen contingencies.
